title: Customer Order Setup
description: Looks up the customer and checks stock for the requested product. Creates a deal and lets the user confirm the product. Creates the purchase order, notifies the user, opens a setup ticket and sends an SMS confirmation
skill:
**Customer Order — Stock-Gated Setup**

Use this Blueprint when a customer orders a product that must be in stock before the order proceeds.

Flow: Find customer → Check stock → [Out of stock: end] → Create deal → User selects product → Create purchase order → Notify user → Open setup ticket → Send confirmation SMS.

Exits after the confirmation SMS. Exits early if the product is out of stock.

agent.name: order_agent
agent.description: A agent optimized for order tasks, workflow assistance, and context-aware support within the system.

knowledge.text: Our office is located at 225 Wood St, London

context.userRequest: I want to order a new product

properties.label: Find Customer
properties.description: Looks up the customer record in HubSpot. Identifies the account the order belongs to

properties.label: Check Stock
properties.description: Searches SAP for the requested material. Returns availability status to gate the next workflow step

properties.label: Check if product is available
properties.description: Evaluates stock availability. Routes to deal creation if available, terminates early if not

properties.label: Complete
properties.description: Ends the workflow when the requested product is out of stock

properties.label: Create Deal
properties.description: Creates a deal for the customer in the sales pipeline. Prepares available options to present to the user

properties.label: User selected product
properties.description: Presents available product options to the user. Pauses the workflow until the user makes a selection

properties.label: Create Purchase Order
properties.description: Creates a purchase order in SAP for the user's selected product

properties.label: Notify Order Created
properties.description: Sends a confirmation notification to the user. Confirms that the purchase order has been created

properties.label: Open Setup Ticket
properties.description: Opens a Zendesk ticket so the setup team can fulfil the order

properties.label: Send Confirmation SMS
properties.description: Sends the customer an SMS confirming the order

properties.label: Complete
properties.description: Marks the entire order setup workflow as successfully completed
